unwindFamily.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.

conditionalDomain.abi: Valid frame/global storage and normal ABI-compatible sibling completion preserving nonvolatile RBX. Each child receives the saved cookie read, even if global cookie changes later.
conditionalDomain.store: The direct store writes its incoming RCX word. Unknown other children may modify cookie/encoded state or hold locks; no final state or startup order is assumed.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Whole owned caller CFG/frame, actual selected CALL and closed no-call store bytes; cookie read and exact eight-byte destination.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Saved cookie is passed to every direct child; one closed child writes it to encoded handler. Caller writes AL true only. The store has no own guard call.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: With a getter using that same saved cookie immediately at the store state, encoded XOR cookie is zero. Subsequent global/callback state and sibling memory effects are not proved.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: A static caller edge does not prove startup invocation/order or absence of an enclosing lock.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Sibling effects and callers/order, complete writer coverage, cookie/encoded epochs and guard initialization, live callback identity and complete positive Buff roots.
